statement: Discard this exact five-performance/seven-commercial campaign and do not apply it to the incumbent Blueprint. The immutable locked review remains KEEP against the old greenfield Benchmark, proving compliance and resilience, but its separate current-factory boundary is REGRESSED by 5.501245 aggregate and every locked case loses 4.023046 to 5.747647 points. Run 109 confirms the causal trade: eight more low-value devices and no terminal Burn-in tail are outweighed by twelve less gross portfolio value and 2.170767 more average Objective-equivalent WIP. Retain the finite campaign mechanism and chronology evidence as reusable design capability; retire only this authored schedule, and require future back-end timing proposals to improve the current factory rather than merely remain above a historical baseline.
